instruction.text: What can you tell about Sparta from the map?

b: Sparta is at the top of a hill.

atoms.text: Many Greek city-states were located directly on the sea and had skilled sailors. Athens, for example, was famous for its large naval fleet.

Sparta, on the other hand, gained its wealth and influence by conquering areas of fertile land. In order to keep the defeated peoples firmly under control, Sparta developed a very strong army and became a military state.

instruction.text: Drag the descriptions to the correct city-state.

atoms.b: The Spartans had quite a unique system of government — they were ((++ruled fooled)) by two kings!
Sparta also had a parliament but, unlike in Athens, Spartan citizens were not able to make their own ((++suggestions bread)).
Like most other city-states, Sparta also had a large population of enslaved people. According to ancient ((++historians geographers)), they were treated particularly cruelly in Sparta.

instruction.text: Spartan children had a particularly strict upbringing. Select the correct answer.

What kind of job do you think Spartan boys were trained for?

feedback.end: Spartan boys were trained to be soldiers from a young age.
